stdout:
Project-level backlog and documentation manager.

Usage: papyrus [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  init         Initialize a project
  config       Read and edit configuration
  check        Run read-only project diagnostics
  milestone    Manage milestones
  release      Manage releases
  task         Manage tasks
  decision     Manage decision records
  import       Import records from a Backlog.md store
  browser      Serve the local web interface
  search       Search records by free text
  audit        Manage audit documents.
  glossary     Manage glossary documents.
  nfr          Manage nfr documents.
  note         Manage note documents.
  req          Manage req documents.
  rule         Manage rule documents.
  tech-spec    Manage tech-spec documents.
  test-case    Manage test-case documents.
  test-report  Manage test-report documents.
  ui-mockup    Manage ui-mockup documents.
  ui-spec      Manage ui-spec documents.
  use-case     Manage use-case documents.
  help         Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json           Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
      --dir <path>     Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --config <file>  Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --no-color       Disable ANSI color output.
  -h, --help           Print help
  -V, --version        Print version
